patch_description: The current program uses slow stochastic hill-climbing and SLSQP with 182 constraints, achieving ratio² ≈ 0.2400 (score 1.00). The new program replaces stochastic search with a smooth log-sum-exact surrogate of the ratio with an exact analytic Jacobian, optimized by L-BFGS-B over an annealing schedule p = 4→8→16→32→64 (sharpening the smooth min/max toward the true ones). Key parameters: 40 diverse seeds (random spheres, antipodal pairs, icosahedron+axis pairs, cube+center, Fibonacci lattice, perturbed best-known structures), 6 L-BFGS-B stages of 200 iterations each with annealed sharpness, then SLSQP max-min polishing (t ≤ d² ≤ 1) on the top 8 candidates with random restarts. Fixed seed 42, total runtime ~2–4s. This should push the squared ratio slightly above the 1/4.165849767 reference.
